authorization.operator: 2026-10-03 grant of Path A and the executive instructions of HENRI-ARCH-2026-SYSTEMIC-EVALUATION-V3 (message body)
authorization.blueprint_bound: sec 2.4: codebook size K <= 512 (domain-specific typed primitives)

design.held_FIXED_vs_the_earlier_refusal: the 512-way manifold AND the 48 atomic ingredients are identical for BOTH arms. Only the DECISION STRUCTURE differs. This isolates decomposition from manifold size and from ingredient count -- the two confounds that produced the earlier TABLE_REPORTED.
design.readout: training-free nearest class mean (no optimizer, no lr)
design.control: per-sample block permutation of the same wave family

gate: G-SC-FLAT: flat joint >= 0.80 AND typed - flat < 0.10
why_this_is_the_right_gate_to_land_on: the arms are within 0.002 at n=1024 (1 SE ~ 0.005), so they are INDISTINGUISHABLE. Claiming a typed advantage would be claiming a difference smaller than one standard error.

DECOMPOSITION_REFUSED_FOR_ACCURACY.statement: at 48 atomic ingredients a single flat 512-way head already reaches 0.9746, so typed decomposition adds no accuracy. The blueprint's rationale for item 3 was that a large flat manifold is less accurate; at this ingredient count that premise does not hold.
DECOMPOSITION_REFUSED_FOR_ACCURACY.ingredient_caveat_is_what_makes_this_sha: the capacity sweep showed flat 512-way over 512 ARBITRARY tokens falls to 0.5449. So the manifold size is NOT the controlling variable -- the ATOMIC INGREDIENT COUNT is (ingredient_count_law_probe.py: 513 ingredients 0.5146 -> 72 ingredients 0.9287, manifold held at 512).

WHAT_TYPED_DECOMPOSITION_IS_STILL_FOR.not_accuracy: measured: no accuracy gain at 48 ingredients
but_still_required_for: strong typing -- a 512-way unconstrained index cannot express 'this output must be a valid tool id', whereas two heads each validated against their own closed manifold can
fail-closed routing -- per-field margins (tool m, arg m) let a consumer refuse one field without discarding the other; a joint argmax offers no such decomposition
verified coordinates -- the blueprint names validated spatial coordinates, which need range checks a joint label cannot carry
auditability -- an action log records (field, id, margin) per field
WHAT_TYPED_DECOMPOSITION_IS_STILL_FOR.reading: the measured value of typed outputs is SAFETY AND ROUTING, not accuracy. That is a corrected rationale, not a refutation of the blueprint item.

D23_SELF_CAUGHT_DEFECT_FIXED_BEFORE_THE_.first_draft: tight = min(joint_ctrl, tool_ctrl, arg_ctrl, flat_ctrl); ctl_ok = tight < 3 * CHANCE
D23_SELF_CAUGHT_DEFECT_FIXED_BEFORE_THE_.fault_1: min() reports the BEST control, so an elevated control is hidden -- a gate that can only pass
D23_SELF_CAUGHT_DEFECT_FIXED_BEFORE_THE_.fault_2: per-field controls were compared against the JOINT chance (1/512), but tool chance is 1/32 and arg chance is 1/16. At 32x16 the tool threshold would have been 3/512 = 0.0059 against a tool chance of 0.031 -- an impossible bar that min() then masked.
D23_SELF_CAUGHT_DEFECT_FIXED_BEFORE_THE_.fix: every control is compared against 3x ITS OWN field's chance, and the WORST ratio is reported
D23_SELF_CAUGHT_DEFECT_FIXED_BEFORE_THE_.caught_by: running the smoke and reading the output against the code, before the real run

honest_limits: single corpus, 4 train templates per class
n=1024 held-out -> 1 SE ~ 0.005, so the +0.0020 delta is not resolvable and is NOT claimed as a difference in either direction
CPU only; not a latency claim
this is a typed-manifold result, NOT a 32,000-token wave->text result
class: a pre-registered gate that fires for the FLAT arm and thereby corrects the rationale for typed outputs
